Settings_NetworkDevice_Text: Select the network device to read from:
Settings_GameCapturePreference_Desc:
Select which game version you want ZDPS to capture from.
Auto will automatically detect and use the currently running version. Two simultaneous clients will cause data problems while on Auto.
Steam and Standalone will only listen for data from their respective versions, allowing both to be run simultaneously and only report DPS for one.
Settings_Keybinds_Notice: Keybinds only work while the game is in focus if ZDPS is being run as Administrator. This is a limitation imposed by the Game Devs.
Settings_Keybinds_Text: Below are global hotkey keybinds for the application. Click on the box and press a key to bind it. Modifier keys (Ctrl/Alt/Shift) are not supported.
Settings_PressEscapeToCancelRebinding: Press Escape to cancel the rebinding process.
Settings_Keybinds_EncounterReset_Warning: [Split Encounters On New Phases] is Enabled. You likely do not need this keybind to manually reset an Encounter. ZDPS will handle Encounter separation for you.
Settings_Keybinds_PinnedWindowClickthrou: This allows your mouse input to go 'through' the pinned (Top Most) window, ignoring it, and interacting with whatever may be behind it such as the game or another application.
Settings_Keybinds_ToggleWindowMinimize_D: This will let you minimize, or restore, the Main Window with a key press.
